sport-gloves-slingshot.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Slingshot
sport-gloves-slingshot.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

ak-47-crane-flight.name: AK-47 | Crane Flight
ak-47-crane-flight.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A crane and gold accents have been hand painted over a black and white base.

Preceding the blood moon

ak-47-wasteland-rebel.name: AK-47 | Wasteland Rebel
ak-47-wasteland-rebel.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been distressed, block printed, and painted with graffiti.

One day they will ask why we fight, and when they do they will understand - Naomi, Bodyguard to Valeria Jenner

ak-47-jet-set.name: AK-47 | Jet Set
ak-47-jet-set.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. Its stock has been wrapped in brown leather.  This weapon has been to a lot of cities.

Anyone paying close attention will connect the dots and see what she did. We don't have much time to find a solution... - A Father's Love Part 1

ak-47-nouveau-rouge.name: AK-47 | Nouveau Rouge
ak-47-nouveau-rouge.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a wine and white-colored base and finished with gold accents.

"Don't look at it that way—it's an art piece, not a tool for violence"

awp-worm-god.name: AWP | Worm God
awp-worm-god.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted with the image of a skull and roots using high-durability enamel paints.

There are some roots you don't want to take hold

pp-bizon-rmx.name: PP-Bizon | RMX
pp-bizon-rmx.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted with a purple gradient and a red and white design.

Light, fast, and dangerous... in theory

cz75-auto-twist.name: CZ75-Auto | Twist
cz75-auto-twist.desc: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted with a spiral design leaving the handle white.

cz75-auto-tacticat.name: CZ75-Auto | Tacticat
cz75-auto-tacticat.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been hand painted pink and purple and features small, feline decals.

24 bullets, 9 lives

cz75-auto-hexane.name: CZ75-Auto | Hexane
cz75-auto-hexane.desc: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted using a hexagon patterned hydrographic.

desert-eagle-sunset-storm-ichi.name: Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱
desert-eagle-sunset-storm-ichi.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted with a hydrographic of a stormy sea over a red metallic base coat.

You think it's the same, but look again... subtlety makes all the difference

desert-eagle-blue-ply.name: Desert Eagle | Blue Ply
desert-eagle-blue-ply.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been laminated and filled with an ash-colored grip and blue slide.

WARNING: This is a replica and has not been tested with live ammunition

dual-berettas-cobalt-quartz.name: Dual Berettas | Cobalt Quartz
dual-berettas-cobalt-quartz.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted with metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact

dual-berettas-cartel.name: Dual Berettas | Cartel
dual-berettas-cartel.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been engraved with skeletons, flowers and serpents.

That's why Huxley is doing the heavy lifting, all we have to is nudge her forward... - The Serpent and The Truth Seeker, Part 2

dual-berettas-twin-turbo.name: Dual Berettas | Twin Turbo
dual-berettas-twin-turbo.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. A custom paint job paying homage to an Italian racing car has been applied.

Always an underdog

dual-berettas-royal-consorts.name: Dual Berettas | Royal Consorts
dual-berettas-royal-consorts.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. Between the green dyed pearl handled grips, gryphon side plates, and laser etched slide; these pistols redefine elegance.

Face off and release the doves

famas-rapid-eye-movement.name: FAMAS | Rapid Eye Movement
famas-rapid-eye-movement.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted with pink interlocking squares. The squares are painted with lifelike eyes.

Frantic are the eyes of the dreamer

five-seven-berries-and-cherries.name: Five-SeveN | Berries And Cherries
five-seven-berries-and-cherries.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. The slide has been painted half red and half blue.

Woop-woop!

five-seven-flame-test.name: Five-SeveN | Flame Test
five-seven-flame-test.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. A silver flame on the muzzle overlays a purple base with a metal flake finish.

Element detected: Cs

five-seven-coolant.name: Five-SeveN | Coolant
five-seven-coolant.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. The slide features a teal hydrographic pattern of interweaving pipes.

A handheld heat rejection device

five-seven-fraise-crane.name: Five-SeveN | Fraise Crane
five-seven-fraise-crane.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. A pink and white pattern of cranes and flowers has been applied.

Best paired with a glass of sherry

g3sg1-desert-storm.name: G3SG1 | Desert Storm
g3sg1-desert-storm.desc: The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been painted using a desert camouflage hydrographic.

galil-ar-cerberus.name: Galil AR | Cerberus
galil-ar-cerberus.desc: A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom painted with a depiction of Cerberus, the mythical three headed dog that guards the underworld.

galil-ar-destroyer.name: Galil AR | Destroyer
galil-ar-destroyer.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom painted with the word "DESTROYER", but it can only be read from certain angles.

Destroy them all

glock-18-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler
glock-18-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

glock-18-umbral-rabbit.name: Glock-18 | Umbral Rabbit
glock-18-umbral-rabbit.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with a dreamlike scene of a mystical rabbit hopping before a full moon.

Take a leap of faith

butterfly-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Damascus Steel
butterfly-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has some damascus steel parts.

paracord-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Night Stripe
paracord-knife-night-stripe.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

classic-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Classic Knife | Night Stripe
classic-knife-night-stripe.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

falchion-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Case Hardened
falchion-knife-case-hardened.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

falchion-knife-autotronic.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Autotronic
falchion-knife-autotronic.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

flip-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Flip Knife | Gamma Doppler
flip-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

gut-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Gut Knife | Tiger Tooth
gut-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

navaja-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Doppler
navaja-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

kukri-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Case Hardened
kukri-knife-case-hardened.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

m9-bayonet-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Doppler
m9-bayonet-doppler-phase-2.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m9-bayonet-doppler-ruby.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Doppler
m9-bayonet-doppler-ruby.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

nomad-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Doppler
nomad-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

skeleton-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Doppler
skeleton-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

skeleton-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Doppler
skeleton-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

stiletto-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Case Hardened
stiletto-knife-case-hardened.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

ursus-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Tiger Tooth
ursus-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

m249-humidor.name: M249 | Humidor
m249-humidor.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been spray-painted with a brown and purple vine and flower pattern.

"What are they keeping in there?"

m249-contrast-spray.name: M249 | Contrast Spray
m249-contrast-spray.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go

m4a4-the-emperor.name: M4A4 | The Emperor
m4a4-the-emperor.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted using the Emperor tarot card as inspiration.

Lead with your head, even if it means ignoring your heart

m4a4-radiation-hazard.name: M4A4 | Radiation Hazard
m4a4-radiation-hazard.desc: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

mac-10-last-dive.name: MAC-10 | Last Dive
mac-10-last-dive.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been hand painted with a randomized green and orange pattern.

There's beauty in chaos

mac-10-lapis-gator.name: MAC-10 | Lapis Gator
mac-10-lapis-gator.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been given a hydrographic of vibrant alligator skin.

Airboat not included

mac-10-red-filigree.name: MAC-10 | Red Filigree
mac-10-red-filigree.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. A red millefleur hydrographic has been applied.

Perhaps this is one piece of art better left in the past

mac-10-hot-snakes.name: MAC-10 | Hot Snakes
mac-10-hot-snakes.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with a bronze snakeskin pattern and a coiled snake beneath the wire form butt.

The hissing is bullets flying past you

mac-10-poplar-thicket.name: MAC-10 | Poplar Thicket
mac-10-poplar-thicket.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. A green forest pattern has been applied.

In the thick of it

mag-7-metallic-ddpat.name: MAG-7 | Metallic DDPAT
mag-7-metallic-ddpat.desc: The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been painted using an urban Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic over a metallic base coat.

mag-7-silver.name: MAG-7 | Silver
mag-7-silver.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent silver anodized effect paint.

There is beauty in simplicity - Franz Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

mp7-special-delivery.name: MP7 | Special Delivery
mp7-special-delivery.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been -REDACTED-

If I do what you want, will you let me go? - The Phoenix and The Storyteller Part 2

mp7-groundwater.name: MP7 | Groundwater
mp7-groundwater.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. This memento from Cache has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in an olive drab color scheme.

Never take victory for granted

mp7-teal-blossom.name: MP7 | Teal Blossom
mp7-teal-blossom.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted with a teal, green, and orange rose bud pattern.

No rose without a thorn

mp7-akoben.name: MP7 | Akoben
mp7-akoben.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted with a blue pattern over a yellow base.

Your personal battle cry

negev-anodized-navy.name: Negev | Anodized Navy
negev-anodized-navy.desc: The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent navy blue anodized effect paint.

nova-modern-hunter.name: Nova | Modern Hunter
nova-modern-hunter.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted using a photographic hunting camo hydrographic.

nova-windblown.name: Nova | Windblown
nova-windblown.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been spray painted with a randomized pattern of a dandelion field.

Get off my lawn

p250-steel-disruption.name: P250 | Steel Disruption
p250-steel-disruption.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a digital disruptive pattern.

p250-muertos.name: P250 | Muertos
p250-muertos.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with circular motifs.

This one is steeped in tradition and blood

p250-x-ray.name: P250 | X-Ray
p250-x-ray.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A custom painted P250 showing its internals with an X-Ray

p90-baroque-red.name: P90 | Baroque Red
p90-baroque-red.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. An intricate maroon and gray Italian inspired pattern has been applied.

Last Supper is served

p90-leather.name: P90 | Leather
p90-leather.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. Its stock has been wrapped in brown leather.

Don't worry, the safety is TSA compliant

p90-sunset-lily.name: P90 | Sunset Lily
p90-sunset-lily.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been spray-painted with a pattern of orange lilies.

While beautiful, lilies are most often associated with death

sawed-off-devourer.name: Sawed-Off | Devourer
sawed-off-devourer.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been hand painted to resemble a creature eating its words.

It's rude to talk with food in your mouth

scar-20-zinc.name: SCAR-20 | Zinc
scar-20-zinc.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. A grayscale pattern has been applied.

A ripple in time

sg-553-colony-iv.name: SG 553 | Colony IV
sg-553-colony-iv.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. A skeletal red ant has been hand painted above gas masks and an orange-yellow current.

Become a part of their world

ssg-08-bloodshot.name: SSG 08 | Bloodshot
ssg-08-bloodshot.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been custom painted with a monstrosity comprised of green tentacles, teeth, and one eyeball.

All the better to see you with

ssg-08-turbo-peek.name: SSG 08 | Turbo Peek
ssg-08-turbo-peek.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. Sports cars race down the side of this custom painted, neon-colored sniper rifle.

Drifting is a right not a privilege

ssg-08-tropical-storm.name: SSG 08 | Tropical Storm
ssg-08-tropical-storm.desc: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been spray-painted using cardboard cutouts, fine mesh, and palm leaves as stencils.

ssg-08-dezastre.name: SSG 08 | Dezastre
ssg-08-dezastre.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been custom painted with a high tech black, white, and red design.

Always follow manufacturer guidelines for safe use

tec-9-bamboo-forest.name: Tec-9 | Bamboo Forest
tec-9-bamboo-forest.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted with a hydrographic of brush-painted bamboo.

I still think it should have a panda - Booth, Arms Dealer

ump-45-continuum.name: UMP-45 | Continuum
ump-45-continuum.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. This custom paint job features alternating bands of black and blue.

Into the void

ump-45-fragment.name: UMP-45 | Fragment
ump-45-fragment.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been custom painted with a silver, black, and red design.

Gone fraggin'

usp-s-kill-confirmed.name: USP-S | Kill Confirmed
usp-s-kill-confirmed.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with the image of a bullet shattering a skull.

2 in the chest, 1 in the head

usp-s-tropical-breeze.name: USP-S | Tropical Breeze
usp-s-tropical-breeze.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. A tropical green floral pattern has been applied. It has been finished with gold accents.

Keep this between us

usp-s-silent-shot.name: USP-S | Silent Shot
usp-s-silent-shot.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with black and blue geometric symbols and shurikens.

Exercise discretion while executing aggression

xm1014-heaven-guard.name: XM1014 | Heaven Guard
xm1014-heaven-guard.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been painted using a combination of subtly patterned hydrographics and dry-transfer decals of wings.

Sometimes the wings of an angel don't mean salvation

xm1014-irezumi.name: XM1014 | Irezumi
xm1014-irezumi.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A snake has been custom painted atop a gold-colored base in a style inspired by the Japanese tattoo art style Irezumi.

Snakes represent wisdom and prophecy, two words which best describe XM1014 users

karambit.name: ★ Karambit
karambit.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger.
